name: Worgen in the Woods
summary: In Darkshire, Calor sends hunters against Nightbane Shadow Weavers in Duskwood. The disillusioned former guardsman is stationed in town, and the hunt runs through Brightwood Grove and the Rotting Orchard. Those who face the worgen prove their mettle to Master Jonathan Carevin's monster hunters.

sections.title: A Private Vigil
sections.body:
The Night Watch struggles against undead, spiders, and outlaws along Darkshire's borders. Calor grew weary of guards too slow and complacent to cleanse the land. He left the Watch and joined Master Jonathan Carevin, turning his blade against heresy and corruption.

Carevin admits no one lightly to his circle. Those who want to aid him must first show they can survive the woods' fiercest horrors.

sections.title: The Nightbane Lurkers
sections.body: Feral worgen rule Brightwood Grove and the blighted Rotting Orchard. Among them, Nightbane Shadow Weavers use dark magic to blind and ensnare their victims before tearing them apart. Calor sends aspiring hunters to slay these spell-weaving beasts. Their courage is tested as the threat is thinned, though its origins deeply unsettle Darkshire's defenders.

sections.title: Monsters from Nowhere
sections.body:
Worgen have become an inescapable nightmare in Duskwood, yet no one can explain their presence. Calor says they seemed to appear from thin air, with no natural lineage in the region. Unlike ravenous feral wolves or corpses risen from local barrows, these bipedal predators wield bizarre, alien sorceries and bring ravenous fury.

Slaying the Shadow Weavers proves a hunter's skill, but only touches the surface of an unnatural infestation taking root across the forest.

aliases: who gives worgen in the woods
faq.answer: Calor is a hunter and former member of Darkshire's Night Watch. Frustrated by the town militia's cautious ways, he joined Master Jonathan Carevin to hunt the creatures threatening Duskwood.

faq.q: Why does Calor want Nightbane Shadow Weavers killed?
faq.answer: Calor uses the Nightbane Shadow Weavers to test skill and courage. Those who want to aid Master Carevin must show they can hunt dangerous spell-weaving worgen and help defend the town.

faq.q: Where are the Nightbane Shadow Weavers found?
faq.answer: Nightbane Shadow Weavers prowl Brightwood Grove and the Rotting Orchard, west and southwest of Darkshire. The orchard grounds are abandoned and overgrown.

faq.q: Where did the worgen in Duskwood come from?
faq.answer: The worgen's sudden appearance is a mystery to Duskwood's people. Calor says the beasts seemed to materialize from nowhere, bringing dark shadow magic and ravenous fury to a forest already on the brink of collapse.
Master Jonathan Carevin is an independent monster hunter based in Darkshire. He and his followers work outside the Night Watch, hunting evil, undead, and bizarre monstrosities across the region.

faq.q: Why did Calor leave the Night Watch?
aliases: why did calor leave the watch
faq.answer: Calor grew disillusioned with what he saw as the Night Watch's passivity and complacency. Rather than manning perimeter fences while darkness closed in, he chose Carevin's active hunt against evil.

angles.text: Darkshire feels abandoned by Stormwind's high seat, leaving townspeople and vigilantes like Calor to seek out any roaming Alliance adventurer who can hold back the monsters.
For humans from Elwynn or Westfall, Duskwood's ruined farms, such as the Rotting Orchard, warn what unchecked dark magic can do to a kingdom's breadbaskets.
Hunting the Nightbane tests tracking and knowledge of beasts to the limit. Worgen are neither natural wildlife nor ordinary human outlaws; they are bipedal horrors wielding shadow spells.
